title: Lucid Advancements
description: A modern overhaul of Minecraft's Advancements screen with a cleaner interface, global progress tracking, powerful search, and a more organized way to browse advancements from every mod.
body:
![Lucid Advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/240930d0420c6d769f1d90835582819310b4d6bb.png) **[SOURCE CODE](https://github.com/Niix-Dan/Lucid-Advancements)** • **[ISSUE TRACKER](https://github.com/Niix-Dan/Lucid-Advancements/issues)** • **[DISCORD COMMUNITY](https://discord.gg/vChttNgJ4v)**
*** **Lucid Advancements** is a complete, client-side overhaul of Minecraft's default Advancements screen. Designed with large modpacks in mind, it replaces the traditional, cluttered advancement tree with a clean, modern, and highly responsive list-based interface. Browse, track, and complete your goals without the visual chaos.
*** ### VISUAL OVERHAUL & ORGANIZATION The vanilla advancement tree can become entirely unreadable when playing with multiple mods. Lucid Advancements solves this by introducing a standardized, accessible layout: * **Global Category View:** Want to see everything at once? Use the new Global View to browse advancements from every category in one unified, easily scrollable list *(Thanks to @VaporeonScripts for the suggestion!)*. * **Categorical Sidebar:** Quickly navigate between different advancement tabs (Minecraft, Nether, Adventure, etc.) using the sleek left-hand sidebar. Categories are now intelligently sorted using **vanilla priority**, keeping your layout familiar and logical. * **Card-Based Layout:** Advancements are displayed as clean, uniform cards, massively improving readability for long descriptions. * **Expandable Requirements:** No more guessing what you are missing. Clicking on an advancement card expands it to reveal a detailed, checked list of its specific requirements.
## ![Expandable Requirements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/934b83ce11c53cee25542c6ccc6d6aed020b6f5d.png)
### ADVANCED SEARCH & FILTERING Finding a specific advancement among thousands is now instant. The top navigation bar includes powerful tools to narrow down your search: * **Global Search Bar:** Search for advancements by Title, Description, or Category. * **Mod-Specific Search:** Use the `@` prefix followed by the mod ID to isolate advancements from a specific mod. > **Examples:** `@minecraft`, `@farmersdelight`, `@create` * **Smart Sorting:** Use the top Filter button to toggle between _All_, _Completed_, _Uncompleted_, or _Challenges_ advancements. *** ### ON-SCREEN TRACKING Keep your current goals in sight at all times. Lucid Advancements features a highly integrated HUD element for tracked advancements, allowing you to monitor your progress in real-time directly from your screen without constantly reopening the menu.
![HUD Tracking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5d4915d3e47b6f9b7032437ce26780dbd777a64.png)
*** ### QUALITY OF LIFE & CUSTOMIZATION * **Requirement Localization (WIP):** Native translations are actively being implemented for advancement requirements! Currently supports English (`en_us`) and Brazilian Portuguese (`pt_br`), making complex goals much easier to understand. * **Dynamic GUI Scale:** A dedicated button allows you to adjust the interface scale on the fly to perfectly fit your monitor setup. Supports: `Auto`, `1` - `4`. * **Global Progress Bar:** A streamlined progress bar at the bottom left tracks your overall completion rate. * **Intuitive Tooltips:** Hover over any advancement icon to view standard item tooltips.
![Global Progress Bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/863752223aa5c85d005c605a76f75d77bcc33ca6.png)
*** ### TECHNICAL INFORMATION **Lucid Advancements** is entirely **Client-Side**. It alters only the graphical interface and tracking mechanics, meaning it is perfectly safe to drop into any existing modpack or server. It reads standard vanilla and modded advancement data seamlessly without altering core mechanics.
